title: OpenScalePayload
description: Target payload schema for IBM Watson OpenScale model scoring records

fields.description: List of input feature / prompt field names

values.description: Matrix of input records corresponding to fields

fields.description: List of output prediction / response field names

values.description: Matrix of output predictions corresponding to fields

scoring_id.description: Unique transaction or scoring event identifier

scoring_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of scoring event

response_time.description: Inference / round-trip response duration in milliseconds

asset_revision.description: Model or prompt template revision tag

multiple_records.description: Indicates if batch scoring contains multiple records

input_tokens.description: Count of prompt tokens (Gen AI only)

output_tokens.description: Count of completion and reasoning tokens (Gen AI only)
